full_judgment:
4. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by presenting a written statement traversing all the allegations made in the plaint. In the written statement it is stated that the suit land appertained to Taluk No.702/29 Patta Md Afsar originally belonged to Obaidur Rahman Choudhury in Maliki right and the suit land had been recorded in Cadestral Survey plot No. 2941. It is specifically pleaded that Obaidul Rahman Chowdhury was in khas possession of the plot No.2943 and he settled the said plot No. 2943 to the defendant No. 1 35 years back at a rent of Taka 6 and the defendant has been possessing the same openly and adversely by growing paddy therein. It is also averred that he paid rent to the superior landlords and received Farogs (Rend receipts) from the landlords. It is further stated that the adjacent eastern plot of CS Dag No.2943 is CS Dag No.2828 which appertained to Taluk No.6299 Lal Mohammad and the said plot was purchased by the father of the plaintiffs. It is the further case of the defendant that during the Survey Settlement Operation the entire land of CS Dag No.2943 was recorded as settlement survey Dag No.389 in the name of the defendant No.1. The plea of limitation and adverse possession have been also taken by the defendant No. 1 in the written statement. 

 14. Let me now advert to the contention pressed into service from the side of the appellant. Admittedly 0.35 acres of CS Dag No. 2943 corresponding to Survey Settlement Dag No.381 is the suit land. It is the case of the plaintiff that the said CS Dag No. 2943 belonged to their father Khalilur Rahman Chowdhury and the said plot was recorded in his name in the CS of 1331 BS Exhibit 5 and 5(a) are the two CS Record of Rights. Exhibit 5 is the CS Record of Right which is in respect of Dag No. 145 of chelte of 1318 BS and Exhibit 5(a) is CS Record of Right which is in respect of Dag No. 146 and 147 of Chelta of 1331 BS. Exhibits 5 and 5(a) suggest that CS Plot No. 2943 appertained to Taluk No. 6299/20 Lal Mohammad and the same belonged to Khalilur Rahamn Chowdhury, the predecessor father of the plaintiffs. It is the assertion of the defendant that the CS Plot No. 2943 appertained to Taluk No. 702/29 Patta Md Afsar and the same belonged to Obaidur Rahman Chowdhury and the defendant No.1 is alleged to have taken settlement from the landlord Obaindur Rahman Chowdhury. Both the courts below concurrently found that CS Plot No. 2943 appertained to Taluk No.6299/20 Lal Mohammad and not to Taluk No. 702/29 Patta Md Afsar and the same belonged to Khalilur Rahman Chowdhury who was inherited by the plaintiffs along with other co-sharers. So, it is evidently clear that the plaintiffs are the owners of the suit land. The sheet anchor of the defendant''s claim, the alleged settlement of the suit land from Obaidur Rahman Chowdhury fall to the ground. The claim of the defendant of exercising acts of possession on the suit land for the last 35 years on the basis of the said settlement got no foundation at all.
